From incoming materials to tested transformer.

Eight stages connect material control, core and coil work, active-part assembly, drying, final assembly and testing.

  1. Material inspection

    Incoming conductor, core steel and insulation materials are checked before release to production.

  2. Core cutting

    Grain-oriented silicon steel is cut, stacked and dimensionally controlled.

  3. Coil winding

    HV and LV windings are wound to the approved design data.

  4. Insulation and leads

    Insulation build-up and lead connections to bushings and tap changer.

  5. Active-part assembly

    Core, coils, leads and clamping structure are integrated.

  6. Vacuum drying

    Moisture is removed from the insulation before oil processing and final assembly.

  7. Tanking and final assembly

    Tank, radiators, bushings, conservator and accessories are fitted.

  8. Routine test and FAT

    Inspection, agreed testing and release records before shipment.

Routine testing, FAT and traceable release records.

Testing scope depends on the product, applicable specification and project contract. Routine, special and witness activities are defined against the agreed inspection and test scope.

  • Routine testsRoutine tests and inspection points completed before release, according to the product and project requirements.
  • Type and special testsArranged when required by the specification or contract.
  • Witness FATCustomer or third-party witness can be defined for agreed FAT and inspection activities.
  • Traceable recordsInspection and test records form part of the project document chain where required.

Questions for factory and tender review.

Final scope is governed by the project specification and contract.

Can FAT be witnessed by the customer or a third party?

Witness arrangements can be included where required by the project and agreed in the inspection and testing scope.

What manufacturing documents can be discussed during tender review?

Typical requirements may include approved drawings, inspection and test records, FAT documentation, packing information and project-specific handover documents.

Can customers arrange a factory visit?

Factory-visit requirements can be submitted through the inquiry form so the relevant product, project stage and visit purpose can be reviewed in advance.
